video.desc:
Famous actor Ray dumps Egan, only to be betrayed by his fiancé and face bankruptcy. Seeking investment, Ray discovers Egan is actually the billionaire heir to the Ashford family. Their roles reversed, they dive into a passionate struggle of power, revenge, and true love.
当红演员 Ray 甩掉了 Egan，转头却被未婚夫背叛，还面临破产。四处寻找投资时，Ray 才发现 Egan 竟然是 Ashford 家族的亿万继承人。身份逆转之后，两人陷入了一场交织着权力、复仇与真爱的激烈纠缠。
